'''Heavy particle cannons''' were turreted weapons mounted onboard [[XR-85 tank droid]]s.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> They had an effective range of five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] and could destroy bunkers in a single shot.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
